progression.narrative: The performance opens on Bb5 and dwells most on Eb in Phrase 1. Phrase 2 (1:25.4) introduces Ab, Ak, centred on Eb. The line peaks at Bb4 (472.9 Hz) at 2:51.6. It closes on Ab4, not the tonic (Ak4 → Bb4 → Bb4 → Eb3 → Ab4 → Ab4).
